Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
PoseKit 3.0

Quick Library
- A small on-screen chip opens a compact animation library. Shown while paired by default; Settings can hide it when solo or never show it (/posekit lib still opens the library).
- Laid out like the main window: your mods, then each animation, then its roles and variants with small play buttons.
- Only shows what you can play right now (standing, seated or lying down), and opens by itself when you sit or lie down (optional).
- Adjust section with the gizmo and Bone Align, and a Rescan button.

Favorites
- Star any playable animation in the main window or the library; favorites get their own section above your mods.

Posing
- Doze anywhere: doze poses play where you stand, and others see them.
- Gizmo: drag handles on your character to move or turn your offset.
- Bone Align faces your partner's direction first ("Face partner's direction", on by default).
- Nudging a remembered animation by hand saves it to Bone Align's memory.

Pairing
- Pair with your target from the library or main window, or right-click a player and choose "Pair with PoseKit". Invites pop up as a notification.
- Pairing tells are hidden from chat and spaced out so the game doesn't drop them.
- The library pairs like the main window (queue, override, partner's pick, Unpair).

Fixes
- Options from mods saved by newer Penumbra versions play again.
- Dropdowns no longer snap back open when collapsed.

- New "What's new" window after updates; reopen it with /posekit changelog.
